description: SACRAMENTO – Today, the Angelique Ashby for Senate campaign unveiled its latest television ad, “My Story.” The ad, which can be seen here and below, hit Sacramento region airwaves over the weekend of October 22-23. “My Story” features Ashby describing her background as a former single mom who put herself through college and law school […]
